# NNNN — Title in imperative form

- **Status:** Proposed
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Deciders:** names / roles
- **Related:** `.github/plan.md` section (if applicable), issue, previous ADR

## Context

What is the situation that forces a decision? Include constraints (team size,
deadline, existing code), not just the ideal. State the problem in two or three
sentences.

## Decision

We will …

State it as a fact ("We will keep …", "We will introduce …"). One decision per
ADR.

## Consequences

**Positive**

- …

**Negative / accepted costs**

- …

**Follow-up work**

- …

## Alternatives considered

| Option | Why rejected |
|---|---|
| … | … |
